有些人主張這項政策違憲。
A sweet smell emanated from the kitchen.
廚房裡散發出一股香甜的味道。
Soft music emanated from the room upstairs.
樓上的房間傳出輕柔的音樂。
She put mascara on her lashes.
她在睫毛上刷了睫毛膏。
A tiny hair fell onto his lash.
一根細小的毛髮掉在他的睫毛上。
Heavy rain lashed the windows all night.
大雨整晚猛烈拍打著窗戶。
The waves lashed against the rocks.
海浪猛烈拍打著岩石。
The sailors lashed the boxes to the deck.
水手們把箱子牢牢綁在甲板上。
He lashed the wood together with strong rope.
他用結實的繩子把木頭捆在一起。
Smartphones are commonplace these days.
現在智慧型手機已經司空見慣。
Such mistakes are commonplace among beginners.
這類錯誤在初學者之間很常見。
Traffic jams are a commonplace in big cities.
塞車在大城市是家常便飯。
His speech was full of commonplaces and nothing new.
他的演講盡是老生常談，毫無新意。
Please refrain from smoking in this area.
請勿在此區域吸菸。
She refrained from saying anything unkind.
她克制自己不說任何難聽的話。
Everyone sang along to the refrain of the song.
大家一起跟著唱這首歌的副歌。
"It's not fair" was his constant refrain.
「這不公平」是他一再重複的口頭禪。
Many Thai people enjoy spicy food.
許多泰國人喜歡吃辣。
She is learning to speak Thai before her trip.
她在旅行前正在學說泰語。
Add water to the concentrated juice before drinking.
喝之前先在濃縮果汁裡加水。
This soap is very concentrated, so use only a little.
這種肥皂很濃縮，只要用一點點。
The population is concentrated in the coastal cities.
人口集中在沿海城市。
A concentrated effort will help us finish on time.
集中力量努力才能讓我們準時完成。

concentrated.zh: 專心；專注（concentrate 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: He concentrated on his homework all evening.
他整個晚上都專心寫功課。
She concentrated hard to solve the puzzle.
她全神貫注地解那道謎題。
The young pianist played brilliantly at the concert.
這位年輕鋼琴家在音樂會上演奏得非常出色。
Our team solved the problem brilliantly.
我們團隊把這個問題解決得很漂亮。
The sun shone brilliantly over the lake.
陽光燦爛地照耀著湖面。
The fireworks lit up the sky brilliantly.
煙火燦爛地照亮了夜空。
She was alarmed to hear a loud noise downstairs.
她聽到樓下傳來巨響而感到驚恐。
Parents were alarmed by the sudden rise in prices.
父母們對物價突然上漲感到憂心。
The sky began to darken before the storm.
暴風雨來臨前天空開始變暗。
Heavy curtains darken the room at night.
厚窗簾讓房間在夜裡暗下來。
Her hair darkened as she grew older.
她的頭髮隨著年紀增長而變深。
The wood will darken over time.
木頭會隨著時間顏色變深。
The cat has two pointed ears.
這隻貓有兩隻尖尖的耳朵。
He wore a pointed hat to the party.
他戴著一頂尖帽子去派對。
She asked a pointed question about the budget.
她針對預算提出一個尖銳的問題。
His pointed remarks made everyone uncomfortable.
他尖刻的評語讓大家都不自在。
He pointed at the map and showed us the way.
他指著地圖為我們指路。
The teacher pointed to the board.
老師指向黑板。
We arrived at the appointed time.
我們在約定的時間抵達。
Everyone gathered at the appointed place.
大家都聚集在指定的地點。

appointed.zh: 任命；指派（appoint 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The company appointed a new manager last month.
公司上個月任命了一位新經理。
She was appointed head of the committee.
她被任命為委員會主席。
The thief tried to evade the police.
小偷試圖躲避警察。
He evaded the question by changing the subject.
他轉移話題來迴避那個問題。
They own a sizeable piece of land near the river.
他們在河邊擁有一大塊土地。
She received a sizeable bonus this year.
她今年拿到一筆可觀的獎金。
Add some crushed ice to the drink.
在飲料裡加一些碎冰。
The crushed box could not be used anymore.
那個被壓扁的箱子已經不能用了。
She felt crushed when she failed the exam.
她考試沒過，覺得大受打擊。
The boy looked crushed after losing the game.
男孩輸掉比賽後看起來很沮喪。

crushed.zh: 壓碎；壓扁（crush 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: He crushed the can with his foot.
他用腳把罐子踩扁。
The heavy rock crushed the small fence.
那塊大石頭壓垮了小圍欄。

insignificant.zh: 無關緊要的；微不足道的
ai: The difference in price is insignificant.
價格上的差異微不足道。
Don't worry about such an insignificant detail.
別擔心這種無關緊要的細節。
The company is at the forefront of green technology.
這家公司處於綠色科技的最前沿。
She was always at the forefront of the movement.
她始終站在這場運動的最前線。
I need a haircut before my interview.
我面試前需要去剪個頭髮。
He got a haircut at the corner barber shop.
他在街角的理髮店剪了頭髮。
I like your new haircut; it suits you.
我喜歡你的新髮型，很適合你。
Her short haircut makes her look younger.
她的短髮讓她看起來更年輕。
The hungry boys devoured the whole pizza in minutes.
飢餓的男孩們幾分鐘就把整個披薩吞光了。
The lion devoured its prey.
獅子吞食了獵物。
She willingly helped us move to the new house.
她樂意幫我們搬到新家。
No one would willingly give up such a chance.
沒有人會心甘情願放棄這樣的機會。
She dressed with great sophistication.
她穿著十分高雅。
The sophistication of the young chef surprised the guests.
這位年輕主廚的細膩手藝讓客人們驚豔。
The sophistication of modern phones is amazing.
現代手機的精密程度令人驚嘆。
The software's sophistication makes it hard to learn.
這套軟體十分複雜，所以很難學。
He carried a hefty bag of rice up the stairs.
他扛著一大包沉重的米爬上樓梯。
A hefty man stood guard at the gate.
一個魁梧的男子在門口站崗。
She had to pay a hefty fine for parking illegally.
她因違規停車必須繳一大筆罰款。
The company made a hefty profit last year.
這家公司去年賺了一大筆利潤。
He had the misfortune to lose his job during the crisis.
他不幸在危機期間失去了工作。
They helped each other through times of misfortune.
他們在不幸的時期互相扶持。
I entrusted my keys to my neighbor while I was away.
我出遠門時把鑰匙託給了鄰居。
The teacher entrusted him with an important task.
老師把一項重要的任務託付給他。
The soup will thicken as it cools.
湯涼了之後會變濃稠。
The fog began to thicken around the lake.
湖邊的霧開始變濃。
Add a little flour to thicken the sauce.
加一點麵粉讓醬汁變濃稠。
Exercise can thicken your muscles.
運動可以讓你的肌肉變厚實。
The company will despatch the goods tomorrow morning.
公司明天早上就會發貨。
They despatched a team to help the flood victims.
他們派遣了一個小組去幫助水災災民。
The despatch of the package was delayed by the storm.
包裹的發送因暴風雨而延誤。
A despatch from the front arrived at midnight.
一封來自前線的急件在午夜送到。
She is an adventurous girl who loves hiking alone.
她是個愛冒險的女孩，喜歡獨自健行。
Try something adventurous, like eating a new dish.
試試一些有冒險精神的事，像是吃一道沒吃過的菜。
The shopkeeper greeted every customer with a smile.
店主笑著招呼每位顧客。
I asked the shopkeeper where I could find batteries.
我問店主哪裡可以買到電池。
The storm severed the power lines.
暴風雨切斷了電線。
The country severed ties with its neighbor.
這個國家與鄰國斷絕了關係。
They roved across the countryside for weeks.
他們在鄉間漫遊了好幾週。
His eyes roved around the room looking for his friend.
他的目光在房間裡四處搜尋朋友。
The heat in the room was intolerable.
房間裡熱得令人無法忍受。
His rude behavior became intolerable.
他的無禮行為變得讓人無法忍受。
The heater radiates warmth throughout the room.
暖爐把暖意散發到整個房間。
Roads radiate out from the center of the town.
道路從鎮中心向四面八方延伸。
She radiated happiness on her wedding day.
她在婚禮那天洋溢著幸福。
He radiates confidence when he speaks.
他說話時散發著自信。
Please don't pry into my private life.
請不要打探我的私生活。
She pried into her sister's diary.
她偷窺了姐姐的日記。
He pried the lid off the can with a screwdriver.
他用螺絲起子把罐蓋撬開。
The thieves pried open the window.
小偷把窗戶撬開。
She put the folded shirts in the dresser.
她把摺好的襯衫放進五斗櫃。
A mirror hangs above the dresser in the bedroom.
臥室裡的梳妝臺上方掛著一面鏡子。
He is a sharp dresser who always looks great.
他很會穿衣服，總是看起來很帥。
She is a casual dresser and loves jeans.
她穿著隨性，很愛穿牛仔褲。
